scope: One existing prepared baseline 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG, 513x259, identical resident bytes to independent RGBA8; single CPU. Inverse DCT SIMD only; no uniform parity claim.
provenance: Prepared owned quality-69 JPEG from HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8), original deterministic asymmetric RGBA8 flattened once on RGB 0x204060. No additional source raster, upstream corpus or quality enumeration.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

baselineAttribution.scope: Separate baseline warm JPEG decode CPU sampling; actual workload loops including warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.

changedPrimitive: Inverse DCT only: safe AVX-512 eight-pixel or AVX four-pixel lanes. Frozen owned basis transposed into 512 static bytes; identical v/u order, separate multiplies, scalar final rounding/clamp, 4096 logical work, scalar fallback. No per-block/image allocation, cache, dependency or unsafe code.
uncertainty: Two independent three-sample screens guide ranking. Conservative upper uses managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean divided by the smaller native bracket lower mean with the same critical value. Failed post-run rolling-load samples remain; later quiet checks do not prove hypervisor isolation.
